period_note: Year-end position for FY2013 (NRB Bank Limited's first, partial financial year: the bank commenced banking operations on 4 August 2013, so this covers under 5 months of trading). This archive's own nrbbank-annual-report-2013.txt is corrupted by a systematic font/encoding fault: the PDF embeds a custom font subset without a usable ToUnicode CMap, so pdftotext -layout substitutes a consistent but non-standard Unicode code point for most Latin letters and digits across roughly 56% of the document's lines (5,032 total), including its own 'Financial Highlights & Value Added Statement' table and its own Balance Sheet ('PROPERTY AND ASSETS' at line 2855). The substitution is a stable 1:1 cipher (spot-decoded manually: e.g. digits 0-9 map to 'Ϭϭ Ϯ ϯ ϰ ϱ ϲ...', 'Total Assets' prints as 'dŽƚĂůƐƐĞƚƐ'), so the figures ARE independently recoverable, and decoding the cipher for Total Assets (5,966) and Total Shareholders' Equity (4,011) reproduces the values below exactly (to the nearest whole million). Rather than decode the full cipher, this year's figures are sourced from the immediately following nrbbank-annual-report-2014.txt's own 'TWO-YEAR PROGRESSION OF NRB BANK' and 'FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS' tables (both fully legible, exact-taka for Total Assets/Total Equity, whole-BDT-million for the rest), which is the same adjacent-report-recovery approach the project methodology uses for scanned/unreadable source years. Required Capital is the regulatory floor (Bangladesh Bank's flat minimum paid-up/capital requirement for banks, BDT 4,000m) since the bank's risk-weighted assets were tiny relative to capital in its first year (CRAR 196.4%), making the flat floor -- not the 10%-of-RWA figure -- the binding 'required capital' concept; no exact RWA figure is disclosed for FY2013 so this is not decomposed further. ROE/ROA are calculated on period-end (not average) equity/assets over a non-annualized, partial (under 5-month) operating period, so they are not comparable to later full-year figures and are flagged accordingly in ratios_timeseries.json. EPS is not disclosed for FY2013 and share-count timing during the founding year is uncertain, so it is left as a gap rather than estimated.
